name: Endless Roller
author: Addicting Games
description: Endless Roller is a free racing game. This is a fast-paced endless runner style game where you need to survive for as long as you can. As a humble ball, you'll try and roll your way to victory by dodging many obstacles and challenges in this fun, free racing game. This is a game all about durability and survival. The winners will be those who are able to dodge the blocks, take the jumps, avoid the pitfalls, and stay on track towards a glorious 8-bit future. The game only gets faster and harder the longer you play, so, don't expect any reprieve from the suffering until after you die. Such is existence in a future world where rolling is the only escape and there is no end. Endless Roller us a game which requires Laser fast reflexes and razor-sharp precision in order to navigate your way through the floating space maze in the sky. Your only way of gauging your distance or your success in this game will be by keeping close tabs on the leaderboard. How far will you go and how long will it take you to get there? Only time will tell.
